text_block_list.text: It's just like you said! One race down!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Good luck at the next one! I'll be
watching!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Things are off to a great start, and the
crowd is
certainly pleased. But as for
Smart Falcon
herself...

Looks like our next race is the Teio Sho
in June!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
2,000 meters... It's a little on the long
side, so we
need a strategy, stat!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is not exactly wild with
excitement,
despite securing a fantastic
first win.

Instead, she's already looking ahead,
eyeing her
next win.

Yoohoo, you okay? Come on, let's head
back to
the academy!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Quick as lightning! ☆ In a flash! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She's at least acting like her usual self,
so I can't
bring myself to say anything to
her. For now, I
switch gears to focus on
the Teio Sho.
